client_identity_valid.name: client_identity_valid
client_identity_valid.value:
(
    ("clients"."type" = 'individual' and "clients"."first_name" is not null and "clients"."last_name" is not null
      and length(trim("clients"."first_name")) > 0 and length(trim("clients"."last_name")) > 0
      and "clients"."legal_name" is null and "clients"."trade_name" is null and "clients"."contact_name" is null
      and "clients"."ice" is null and "clients"."tax_identifier" is null and "clients"."registration_number" is null
      and "clients"."registration_city" is null and "clients"."professional_tax_number" is null)
    or ("clients"."type" = 'company' and "clients"."legal_name" is not null and length(trim("clients"."legal_name")) > 0 and "clients"."first_name" is null and "clients"."last_name" is null)
  )

client_delivery_address.name: client_delivery_address
client_delivery_address.value:
(
    ("clients"."delivery_address_line1" is null and "clients"."delivery_address_line2" is null and "clients"."delivery_city" is null
      and "clients"."delivery_postal_code" is null and "clients"."delivery_country_code" is null)
    or ("clients"."delivery_address_line1" is not null and length(trim("clients"."delivery_address_line1")) > 0
      and "clients"."delivery_city" is not null and length(trim("clients"."delivery_city")) > 0
      and "clients"."delivery_country_code" is not null and "clients"."delivery_country_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
  )

delivery_note_lines_variant_pair.name: delivery_note_lines_variant_pair
delivery_note_lines_variant_pair.value: "delivery_note_lines"."product_variant_id" is null or "delivery_note_lines"."product_id" is not null

delivery_notes_prepared_data.name: delivery_notes_prepared_data
delivery_notes_prepared_data.value: ("delivery_notes"."status" = 'draft' and "delivery_notes"."number" is null) or ("delivery_notes"."status" <> 'draft' and "delivery_notes"."number" is not null)

estimate_lines_variant_pair.name: estimate_lines_variant_pair
estimate_lines_variant_pair.value: "estimate_lines"."product_variant_id" is null or "estimate_lines"."product_id" is not null

estimates_issued_data.name: estimates_issued_data
estimates_issued_data.value: ("estimates"."status" = 'draft' and "estimates"."number" is null and "estimates"."issued_at" is null) or ("estimates"."status" <> 'draft' and "estimates"."number" is not null and "estimates"."issued_at" is not null and "estimates"."valid_until" is not null)

invoice_lines_variant_pair.name: invoice_lines_variant_pair
invoice_lines_variant_pair.value: "invoice_lines"."product_variant_id" is null or "invoice_lines"."product_id" is not null

invoices_issued_data.name: invoices_issued_data
invoices_issued_data.value: ("invoices"."status" = 'draft' and "invoices"."number" is null and "invoices"."issued_at" is null) or ("invoices"."status" <> 'draft' and "invoices"."number" is not null and "invoices"."issued_at" is not null and "invoices"."due_date" is not null)

invoices_conversion_pair.name: invoices_conversion_pair
invoices_conversion_pair.value: ("invoices"."conversion_operation_id" is null) = ("invoices"."conversion_request" is null) and ("invoices"."source_estimate_id" is null or "invoices"."conversion_operation_id" is not null)

notification_rules_timing.name: notification_rules_timing
notification_rules_timing.value: "notification_rules"."offset_days" between -365 and 365 and ("notification_rules"."repeat_every_days" is null or "notification_rules"."repeat_every_days" between 1 and 365) and ("notification_rules"."event_key" in ('invoice_due_reminder','estimate_expiry_reminder') or ("notification_rules"."offset_days" = 0 and "notification_rules"."repeat_every_days" is null))

outbound_messages_lease.name: outbound_messages_lease
outbound_messages_lease.value: ("outbound_messages"."status" = 'sending') = ("outbound_messages"."lease_token" is not null and "outbound_messages"."locked_until" is not null)

outbound_messages_completion.name: outbound_messages_completion
outbound_messages_completion.value: ("outbound_messages"."status" = 'sent') = ("outbound_messages"."sent_at" is not null and "outbound_messages"."provider_message_id" is not null)

payments_method_fields.name: payments_method_fields
payments_method_fields.value:
(
      ("payments"."method" = 'cash' and "payments"."status" <> 'pending' and "payments"."bank_account_id" is null and "payments"."reference" is null and "payments"."cheque_bank" is null and "payments"."cheque_number" is null)
      or ("payments"."method" = 'bank_transfer' and "payments"."reference" is not null and length(trim("payments"."reference")) > 0 and "payments"."cheque_bank" is null and "payments"."cheque_number" is null)
      or ("payments"."method" = 'cheque' and "payments"."cheque_bank" is not null and length(trim("payments"."cheque_bank")) > 0 and "payments"."cheque_number" is not null and length(trim("payments"."cheque_number")) > 0 and "payments"."reference" is null)
    )

payments_status_dates.name: payments_status_dates
payments_status_dates.value:
(
      ("payments"."status" = 'pending' and "payments"."collected_on" is null and "payments"."confirmed_at" is null and "payments"."cancelled_at" is null and "payments"."cancellation_reason" is null)
      or ("payments"."status" = 'confirmed' and "payments"."collected_on" is not null and "payments"."confirmed_at" is not null and "payments"."cancelled_at" is null and "payments"."cancellation_reason" is null)
      or ("payments"."status" = 'cancelled' and "payments"."cancelled_at" is not null and "payments"."cancellation_reason" is not null and length(trim("payments"."cancellation_reason")) > 0)
    )

report_runs_trigger.name: report_runs_trigger
report_runs_trigger.value: "report_runs"."trigger" in ('scheduled', 'test') and ("report_runs"."trigger" <> 'test' or "report_runs"."created_by_user_id" is not null)

report_runs_lease.name: report_runs_lease
report_runs_lease.value: ("report_runs"."status"='running' and "report_runs"."lease_token" is not null and "report_runs"."locked_until" is not null) or ("report_runs"."status"<>'running' and "report_runs"."lease_token" is null and "report_runs"."locked_until" is null)

report_runs_complete.name: report_runs_complete
report_runs_complete.value: "report_runs"."status" not in ('succeeded','failed','cancelled') or "report_runs"."finished_at" is not null

report_schedules_cadence.name: report_schedules_cadence
report_schedules_cadence.value: ("report_schedules"."frequency"='daily' and "report_schedules"."weekday" is null and "report_schedules"."month_day" is null) or ("report_schedules"."frequency"='weekly' and "report_schedules"."weekday" is not null and "report_schedules"."weekday" between 1 and 7 and "report_schedules"."month_day" is null) or ("report_schedules"."frequency"='monthly' and "report_schedules"."weekday" is null and "report_schedules"."month_day" is not null and "report_schedules"."month_day" between 1 and 28)

report_schedules_sections_unique.name: report_schedules_sections_unique
report_schedules_sections_unique.value: array_position("report_schedules"."included_sections", null) is null and cardinality("report_schedules"."included_sections") = (case when 'summary'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'revenue'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'collections'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'outstanding'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'overdue'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'payment_methods'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'pending_cheques'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'vat'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'sales_by_client'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'sales_by_product'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'sales_by_category'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'estimates'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end + case when 'deliveries'=any("report_schedules"."included_sections") then 1 else 0 end)

report_schedules_active.name: report_schedules_active
report_schedules_active.value: ("report_schedules"."enabled" and "report_schedules"."next_run_at" is not null and "report_schedules"."archived_at" is null) or (not "report_schedules"."enabled" and "report_schedules"."next_run_at" is null)

bank_identifier.name: bank_identifier
bank_identifier.value: "bank_accounts"."rib" is not null or "bank_accounts"."iban" is not null
